blocks.text: Technology entrepreneurship offers a variety of career pathways for students in the digital age. Individuals can become startup founders by developing and launching their own digital businesses. Others may work as freelancers in fields such as programming, graphic design, and digital marketing. Careers in app development, e-commerce management, and online consultancy are also growing rapidly. With the rise of technology, students can also become innovators who create new digital solutions for real-world problems.
